verdict.rationale: Svelte's core value proposition—a compiler producing surgical DOM updates instead of a virtual DOM/manual diffing—is documented directly in first-party docs and GitHub description, and corroborated by community reports of 'snappy' apps and 'pretty readable' generated code. Missing for 10: independent benchmark data comparing update efficiency, and one community report notes rendering-performance ceilings at scale (svelte-comm-13) and an old transpilation bug (svelte-comm-14) suggesting the mechanism isn't flawless in every edge case.
